context: Mei's apartment, midweek. Her older "aunt-friend" Naoko has visited from Osaka and is unpacking food in Mei's kitchen, uninvited.
purpose: older-woman-younger-woman intergenerational — Kansai care meets Tokyo gentleness

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: メイちゃん、これ、冷蔵庫入れとき。
lines.en: Mei-chan — get these in the fridge for me.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, already gesturing toward the fridge. Kansai clip to the speech. Efficient, no-nonsense energy while moving.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: なおこさん、本当に多すぎ…
lines.style: Half-laughing at the absurdity, a note of helplessness underneath. Slight disbelief that her small kitchen can hold all this. Warm exasperation.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 多い方がええんよ。一人やろ？
lines.en: More is better. You're living alone, aren't you?
lines.style: Kansai logic delivered as plain fact, mid-action. No question mark — she knows the answer. Practical and unarguable in her delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 一人やないですよ、レンが…
lines.style: Gentle correction wrapped in a small smile. A touch shy about naming him. Not quite a protest, more a soft clarification.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あー、彼ね。元気？ちゃんと食べてる？
lines.en: Ah, that boy. How's he doing? Eating enough?
lines.style: Switches tones mid-sentence without missing a beat, still occupied with arranging containers. Genuine curiosity layered under the Kansai directness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 元気です。本当に、よく食べる。
lines.en: He's doing well. Really — he eats quite a lot.
lines.style: A real fondness audible and visible in the smile. Slight lift in the voice, almost proud. The answer of someone who loves feeding someone.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: よろしい。…で、メイちゃんは、最近、大丈夫？
lines.en: Good. …So, how have you been lately, really?
lines.style: Pauses mid-motion. Voice drops. The busyness falls away — this is the real question underneath. Steady, searching gaze in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: A small honest pause before answering. Meets the question seriously. Quiet and steady — she means it, and she knows she's being heard.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ええわ、それなら。今度、一緒にどっか行こ。
lines.en: Right then. Next time — we should go somewhere together.
lines.style: Already moving again, already thinking ahead. The plan is how she says 'I care.' Practical affection, warm without ceremony.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: はい。時間、ちゃんと作ります。
lines.en: Yes — I'll make time for it, properly.
lines.style: Quiet promise, steady commitment in every word. A small reverence underneath — the recognition of what this means. Almost a small bow audible.
